_note: The sniper (rebuild-heroes.md, section 6, path 1). Numbers are placeholders for the paths report to tune.
name: Deadeye
title: the sniper
fantasy: She plants her feet and makes one shot count.
placement: A corner with a long sightline.

vowed.taste: Steady: after 1.5s without moving, she reaches 1 hex farther and crits more often.

passives.name: Steady
passives.text: After 1.5s without moving, she reaches 1 hex farther.

passives.name: Steady Aim
passives.text: After 1.5s without moving, she crits more often.

passives.name: Unsteady
passives.text: She shoots 2% slower.

transformed.text: Planted for 1.5s, she reaches 2 hexes farther (6) and crits more. Heartseeker replaces Marking Shot: a charged shot that pierces every enemy in its line. Shots from 5 hexes or more give her more mana.
transformed.cost: After she moves, she needs 1.5s to plant before she can shoot again.

signature.name: Heartseeker
signature.text: Charges for 0.8s, then looses a shot at the nearest enemy within 4 hexes (6 once planted) that pierces every enemy in a line 6 hexes long.

passives.name: Planted
passives.text: After 1.5s without moving, she reaches 2 hexes farther.

passives.name: Sure Aim
passives.text: After 1.5s without moving, she crits more often.

deed.text: Damage dealt from beyond 4 hexes (her reach without Steady)

_note: Control (rebuild-heroes.md, section 6, path 2). Transformed, you place her first 2 snares before the fight.
name: Trapper
title: the snarer
placement: Near the front, where her snares go.

vowed.taste: Snare: once a fight, 2s in, she drops a snare in her target's path; it roots whoever steps in it.

passives.name: Snare
passives.text: Once a fight, 2s in, she drops a snare 1 hex ahead of her target, in its path; the first enemy to step in it is rooted.

passives.name: Loose Draw
passives.text: Her shots deal 2% less.

transformed.text: Her snares root for 2.5s and make the enemy Bleed. Bramble Field replaces Marking Shot: it drops a snare in an enemy's path, up to 3 at once. You place her first 2 snares before the fight.

basic_attack.name: Longshot
basic_attack.text: Shoots her target from up to 3 hexes away.

signature.name: Bramble Field
signature.text: Drops a snare 1 hex ahead of the nearest enemy within 3 hexes, in its path; the first enemy in it is rooted for 2.5s and Bleeds. Up to 3 stand at once.

deed.text: Time enemies spend rooted by her

name: Volley
title: the storm of arrows
fantasy: Always moving, filling the air with arrows.
placement: A loose spot with room to move.

vowed.taste: Split Shot: every 4th shot also hits the enemy nearest her target, within 1 hex of it, for a third as much.

passives.name: Light Draw
passives.text: Her shots deal 5% less.

basic_attack.name: Longshot
basic_attack.text: Shoots her target from up to 4 hexes away. Every 4th shot splits: it also hits the enemy nearest her target, within 1 hex of it, for a third as much.

signature.name: Marking Shot
signature.text: Marks the nearest enemy within 4 hexes, so it takes more damage from everyone for a while.

transformed.text: Every shot splits to the enemy nearest her target and gives her mana, and she shoots whatever is in reach while she walks. Arrow Storm replaces Marking Shot: arrows rain on a circle for 3s.

basic_attack.name: Longshot
basic_attack.text: Shoots her target from up to 4 hexes away, even while she walks. Every shot splits: it also hits the enemy nearest her target, within 1 hex of it, for less, and each split gives her mana.

signature.name: Arrow Storm
signature.text: Rains arrows on a circle 1 hex around the biggest group of enemies within 4 hexes: for 3s, every enemy inside is hit twice a second.

deed.text: Extra enemies hit by her shots

_note: The protector (rebuild-heroes.md, section 7, path 1). Guard's reach is provisional (Decision 6: measured, flagged).
name: Hearthwall
title: the protector
fantasy: Nothing reaches the people behind him.
placement: Right in front of Maren and Vell, covering the lane to them.

vowed.taste: Guard: every ally within 2 hexes of him takes 10% less from each hit; he takes it instead.

passives.name: Guard
passives.text: Every ally within 2 hexes of him takes 10% less from each enemy hit; he takes that instead.

passives.name: Braced
passives.text: His Shield Bash deals 2% less.

transformed.text: Guard covers every ally within 2 hexes, taking 30% of each hit on them. Hearthwall replaces Hold the Line: a wall of shields 3 hexes wide, 1 hex in front of him, stops enemy shots for 4s. Damage he takes for others fills his mana faster.
transformed.cost: He's slow, and he can't move while his wall stands.

signature.name: Hearthwall
signature.text: Raises a wall of shields 3 hexes wide, 1 hex toward the nearest enemy within 3 hexes, that stops enemy shots for 4s. He can't move while it stands.

passives.name: Guard
passives.text: Every ally within 2 hexes of him takes 30% less from each enemy hit; he takes that instead.

deed.text: Damage he takes in place of allies

_note: The bruiser (rebuild-heroes.md, section 7, path 2). Its transformed cost is the DEF (Decision 5).
name: Ironbrand
title: the bruiser
fantasy: The best defense is standing in the middle of them and swinging.
placement: Forward, where the enemies bunch up.

vowed.taste: Brand: Shield Bash also hits the enemy nearest his target, within 1 hex of it, for 30%.
vowed.cost: Hold the Line taunts for 1s less.

basic_attack.name: Shield Bash
basic_attack.text: Bashes the enemy in front of him, and brands the enemy nearest it, within 1 hex, for a third as much.

signature.name: Hold the Line
signature.text: Taunts every enemy within 2 hexes of him, so they turn on him instead.

transformed.text: Hearthbrand Mace replaces Shield Bash: it hits every enemy within 1 hex of his target too, heals him for part of the damage, and fills his mana for each enemy hit. Brand Slam replaces Hold the Line: he leaps into the biggest group and knocks them back.

basic_attack.name: Hearthbrand Mace
basic_attack.text: Swings at the enemy in front of him, and at every enemy within 1 hex of it for less; each hit heals him a little and gives him mana.

signature.name: Brand Slam
signature.text: Leaps up to 2 hexes into the biggest group of enemies, then slams every enemy within 1 hex of where he lands, knocking them back 1 hex.

deed.text: Extra enemies hit by one swing

_note: The martyr (rebuild-heroes.md, section 7, path 3). Transformed, he has no mana bar.
name: Last Watch
title: the martyr
fantasy: He's at his most dangerous when he should already be dead.
placement: The most exposed spot, drawing fire from everyone else.

vowed.taste: Unyielding: once a fight, a hit that would fell him leaves him at 1 HP, and he can't fall for 1s.

passives.name: Unyielding
passives.text: Once a fight, a hit that would fell him leaves him at 1 HP, and he can't fall for 1s.

transformed.text: Below 30% HP he hits harder and his DEF rises, and he grows stronger for each fallen ally. Last Rites replaces Hold the Line: the first time he drops below 30% HP, he taunts every enemy within 3 hexes and can't fall for 5s. He has no mana.
transformed.cost: Heals on him are 20% weaker, and he has 5% less max HP.

signature.name: Last Rites
signature.text: The first time he drops below 30% HP, he taunts every enemy within 3 hexes and can't fall for 5s.

passives.name: Last Stand
passives.text: Below 30% HP he hits more than twice as hard.

passives.name: Last Wall
passives.text: Below 30% HP his DEF is a third higher.

passives.name: Grief
passives.text: He hits 20% harder for each ally who has fallen.

passives.name: Scarred
passives.text: Heals on him are 20% weaker.

deed.text: Damage he deals while he can't fall (when he should already be dead)

_note: The pure healer (rebuild-heroes.md, section 8, path 1). Transformed, Night Lantern is her mana signature and Mend comes every 4th Lantern Glow (Decision 7).
name: Lanternbearer
title: the warm light
fantasy: A warm light that keeps everyone standing.
placement: In the middle, behind Brannoc, where her lantern reaches everyone.

vowed.taste: Kindle: Mend also heals the ally nearest its target, within 2 hexes of it, for a fifth as much.

signature.name: Mend
signature.text: Heals whichever ally within 3 hexes is lowest on HP, herself included, and kindles the ally nearest them, within 2 hexes, for a fifth as much.

transformed.text: Night Lantern replaces Mend: a lantern that heals every ally near it each second and burns away their Burn and Poison. Every 4th Lantern Glow, Mend heals the ally lowest on HP, and every ally within 2 hexes of her at half as much.
transformed.cost: Lantern Glow deals no damage (it still gives mana), and she has less HP.

basic_attack.name: Lantern Glow
basic_attack.text: Throws lantern light at her target from up to 3 hexes away. It deals no damage, but it's where most of her mana comes from.

signature.name: Night Lantern
signature.text: Sets a lantern by the ally lowest on HP within 3 hexes: for 5s, every ally within 2 hexes of it heals each second and loses some Burn and Poison.

passives.name: Mend
passives.text: Every 4th Lantern Glow, she heals the ally lowest on HP within 3 hexes.

passives.name: Kindle
passives.text: Every 4th Lantern Glow, she also heals every other ally within 2 hexes of her, at half as much.

deed.text: Healing that Mend gives beside its target

_note: The shielder (rebuild-heroes.md, section 8, path 2). Transformed, Warding Circle is her mana signature and Weave comes every 4th Lantern Glow (Decision 7); her signature doesn't heal, so Wait to heal can't be taken there.
name: Wardweaver
title: the shielder
fantasy: Stop the damage before it lands.
placement: Forward, next to Brannoc; where the circle goes matters.

vowed.taste: Ward Thread: Mend also gives its target a small Shield, and what it would heal past full HP comes back as Shield, a fifth as much.

signature.name: Mend
signature.text: Heals whichever ally within 3 hexes is lowest on HP, herself included, and gives it a small Shield; what it would heal past full HP comes back as Shield too.

transformed.text: Warding Circle replaces Mend: for 4s, a circle 2 hexes around her Slows enemies inside and Wards allies inside (they take 15% less). Every 4th Lantern Glow, Weave shields the ally lowest on HP and heals them a little.

signature.name: Warding Circle
signature.text: Draws a circle 2 hexes around herself for 4s: enemies inside are Slowed, and allies inside are Warded, taking 15% less damage.

passives.name: Weave
passives.text: Every 4th Lantern Glow, she shields the ally lowest on HP within 3 hexes, and heals them a little.

passives.name: Thin Light
passives.text: Her healing is 40% weaker.

_note: The battle cleric (rebuild-heroes.md, section 8, path 3). Transformed, Sunfall is her mana signature and Mend comes every 4th Lantern Glow, as the design says.
name: Vigil Keeper
title: the battle cleric
fantasy: Her light heals friends and burns enemies.
placement: Off to the side, with a clean line for Sunfall.

vowed.taste: Judgment: every 2nd Mend also smites the enemy nearest its target.

signature.name: Mend
signature.text: Heals whichever ally within 2 hexes is lowest on HP, herself included; every 2nd Mend also smites the enemy nearest them.

transformed.text: Sunfall replaces Mend: a beam toward her target that burns enemies and heals allies in its line. Every 4th Lantern Glow, Mend heals the ally lowest on HP and smites her target, giving her mana.

signature.name: Sunfall
signature.text: Casts a beam 4 hexes long toward the nearest enemy within 3 hexes: enemies in it are burned, allies in it healed.

passives.name: Mend
passives.text: Every 4th Lantern Glow, she heals the ally lowest on HP within 3 hexes, smites her target, and gains mana.

passives.name: Dimmed
passives.text: Her healing is 30% weaker.
